payload.note: Torus sparse-maxima flow theorem: orient increasing edges, normalize by W, and set F=sum_x(sum_out alpha_e)^2. If W*F>=24*q^2*diam(T_L^4)*L^4, exact complete-current decomposition plus torus path geometry gives ||grad A||^2/||r||^2>=9q^2. Hence every candidate below this floor has W*F<3072*L^5 and E_theta/(4L^4)<768*L/(theta^2*W); when W/L tends to infinity every fixed relative top band is sparse. This narrows the counterfamily to a sparse multiband hierarchy but leaves the all-field torus bound, an actual collapsing family, Witten/H^-1, continuum, Born/Krein, and Lorentzian gates open.
